title: OCW-RPL: Open Courseware for Software Engineering (Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak)
abstract: Open courseware platform for the Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak (Software Engineering) course IMP307 at Universitas IPWIJA, Jakarta. The platform delivers 16 structured modules covering the full software engineering lifecycle: RPL fundamentals and software characteristics (engineered not manufactured, software decay), feasibility studies using the PIECES framework with Cost-Benefit Analysis, project management principles (The 4P's: People, Product, Process, Project; LOC/Function Point/COCOMO estimation), SDLC model comparison (Waterfall, Prototyping, Spiral, RAD, Agile/Scrum), requirements engineering and SRS documentation (Functional vs Non-Functional vs Domain Requirements, Verification vs Validation), analysis modeling (DFD Level 0/1/2, Kamus Data, Transform vs Transaction Mapping), software design (Cohesion & Coupling metrics, architectural, interface, and data design), testing strategies (White Box: Cyclomatic Complexity V(G)=E-N+2P, Basis Path Testing; Black Box: BVA, Equivalence Partitioning, Decision Table), and Software Quality Assurance (SQA vs Testing distinction, FTR mechanism, McCall's 4 Quality Factors: Correctness, Reliability, Maintainability, Usability; IEEE 730, CMMI). Built on DonatJS, a zero-dependency, no-build-step, JSON-driven micro-framework. Lighthouse audit metrics: Performance 98, Accessibility 92, Best Practices 100, SEO 90. HKI Copyright: EC00202414144. Patent: S00202503129 (DJKI Indonesia).
